To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Na influx into rat aortic smooth muscle occurs via a Na-H exchange pathway and that this pathway is regulated by changes in pH.
Na influx via Na-H exchange in vascular smooth muscle is regulated by extracellular and/or intracellular pH, and that this system is important in maintaining intracellular Na constant in these cells.
Na influx into vascular smooth muscle occurs primarily via the Na-H exchanger and that activation of the exchanger activates the Na-K-ATPase, which maintains intr cellular Na constant.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the mechanism by which the Na-H exchange is regulated in the vascular smooth muscle.
the role of intracellular Na in the regulation of smooth muscle contraction and relaxation.
the role of the Na-H antiporter in regulating intracellular pH in vascular smooth muscle and its role in the regulation of Na and Ca transport.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

Na-H exchange, in addition to Na entry via the Na channel, is a significant mechanism for Na entry into vascular smooth muscle and is an important mechanism for regulating the activity of the sodium pump.
the Na-H antiport plays a major role in Na transport in vascular smooth muscle.
the Na-H exchange is the major pathway for the entry of Na into rat vascular smooth muscle cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Na-H exchange plays a significant role in Na transport in vascular smooth muscle.
Na-H exchange plays a central role in Na transport in vascular smooth muscle.
the Na-H exchanger in vascular smooth muscle is an important pathway for Na entry, and that this pathway is activated by intracellular acidification.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Na influx is a major factor in regulating Na-K pump activity in vascular smooth muscle cells.
in smooth muscle cells the Na-K pump is not a passive process but is activated by the Na-H exchange.
Na-H exchange plays an important role in the regulation of intracellular Na in vascular smooth muscle.
